ModMetaData.name: Bionic Irises for Facial Animation
ModMetaData.author: kelby
ModMetaData.description:
Gives bionic eyes their own iris sprites on [NL] Facial Animation faces, one eye at a time.
- Bionic eye: gunmetal lens with a ring in the pawn's own eye colour. - Advanced bionic eye (EPOE-Forked): silver bezel, segmented ring and hexagonal aperture. - Tactical bionic eye (EPOE-Forked): olive housing with an eye-coloured reticle. - Archotech eye: gold rim, pearl iris and a star-shaped pupil.
Only the accents take the pawn's original eye colour; metal, glass and glints keep their own colours. Each eye is handled separately, so a pawn with one bionic eye keeps one natural eye. Implants that sit on top of an eye, such as EPOE's tactical cornea implant, never change the iris.
Requires Harmony, [NL] Facial Animation - WIP and [NL] Facial Animation - Experimentals. EPOE-Forked is optional. Human pawns only.
